description: This file defines routes for the analytics API in a Node.js Express application. It includes endpoints for health checks, cost metrics, user activity trends, and new user statistics, protected by authentication and tenant requirement middleware.

methods.name: Health HEAD endpoint
methods.description: Health check endpoint for analytics (HEAD request).

methods.name: Health OPTIONS endpoint
methods.description: CORS preflight response for health check.

methods.name: Middleware: Tenant scope bypass logic
methods.description: Middleware that examines headers and query parameters to determine tenant access scope.

methods.name: /llm-cost-by-agent GET
methods.description: Endpoint to retrieve LLM cost by agent, protected by auth and tenant verification.

methods.name: /users/active-trend GET
methods.description: Endpoint to retrieve user activity trends, protected by auth and tenant verification.

methods.name: /users/new-over-time GET
methods.description: Endpoint to retrieve new user counts over time, protected by auth and tenant verification.
